<!doctype html><html lang="en"><head><meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow, noarchive"><meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy" content="upgrade-insecure-requests"><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Zero Itinerary</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{--ink:#0a0a0a;--mut:#616161;--line:#e5e5e5;--soft:#f2f2f2;--client:#A4CCC4}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html{scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:56px}
body{margin:0;background:#fff;color:var(--ink);font:15px/1.55 "Helvetica Neue",Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif}
*,*::before,*::after{font-family:inherit}table,th,td,input,button{font-family:inherit}
.kv,.tv,td,.flt,.grp>div,.slot,.list .li{font-size:15px;line-height:1.5}
a{color:inherit;text-underline-offset:3px}.muted{color:var(--mut)}.pad{padding:12px 16px}p{margin:6px 0 0}
.page{max-width:900px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 0 80px}
nav.top{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:5;background:#fff;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;gap:6px;overflow-x:auto;padding:10px 12px}
nav.top a{flex:none;padding:6px 12px;background:var(--soft);text-decoration:none;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;border-radius:4px}nav.top a:hover{background:var(--ink);color:#fff}
.cover{border-bottom:2px solid var(--ink)}
.banner{position:relative;height:150px;overflow:hidden}.banner h1{position:absolute;left:24px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);margin:0;max-width:55%;font-size:clamp(28px,6vw,48px);font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-.02em;line-height:1.05;text-transform:uppercase;color:#000;z-index:1}
.diag{position:absolute;right:0;top:0;height:100%;width:45%;clip-path:polygon(15% 0,100% 0,100% 100%,0 100%)}.hl{position:absolute;inset:0 0 0 15%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:0 12px}.hl strong{color:#fff;font-size:14px}.hl img{max-height:56px;max-width:min(60%,170px);width:auto;height:auto;object-fit:contain}
.hst{font-weight:700;font-size:22px;color:#fff}.hst b{color:#C4E538}.hst.dark{color:#000}
.meta{padding:28px 24px 8px}.meta h2{display:inline-block;margin:0;font-size:clamp(20px,4vw,30px);font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;border-bottom:2px solid var(--ink)}.meta p{text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;font-size:17px}
.photo{padding:20px 24px;display:flex;justify-content:center}.photo img{width:100%;max-width:440px;aspect-ratio:3/4;object-fit:cover}
.foot{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:18px;padding:12px 24px 28px}.foot img{width:auto;height:auto;max-height:44px;max-width:150px;object-fit:contain}.foot i{width:2px;height:52px;background:#C4E538}
#contents{padding:24px}#contents h2{margin:0 0 12px;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mut)}
.toc{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(180px,1fr));gap:8px}.toc a{display:block;padding:12px 14px;border:1px solid var(--line);font-weight:600;text-decoration:none}.toc a:hover{border-color:var(--ink)}
.sched{margin:24px -8px 0}.sched+.days{margin:0 -8px}.sched .bar a{display:none}#contents .sched .bar h2{margin:0;font-size:19px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:normal;text-transform:uppercase;color:#fff}.days{border:1px solid var(--line);border-top:0}.days a{display:flex;gap:12px;padding:10px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);text-decoration:none}.days a:last-child{border:0}.days a:hover{background:var(--soft)}.days a{align-items:center}.days small{flex:none;white-space:nowrap;min-width:190px;color:var(--ink);font-size:15px}.days .loc{flex:1;min-width:0}.days .tag{margin:0;flex:none;font-size:11px}.days a.show{background:var(--client)}.days a.show small{color:#000}.days a.show:hover{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--client) 80%,#000)}.nw{white-space:nowrap}
section{margin:28px 16px 0}.bar{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;background:var(--ink);color:#fff;padding:12px 20px;scroll-margin-top:56px}.bar h2{margin:0;font-size:19px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase}.bar a{font-size:12px;opacity:.75;text-decoration:none}
.list .li{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;gap:4px 16px;padding:10px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.list .li>div:last-child{text-align:right}
.ti{border:1px solid var(--line);border-top:0}.tr{display:grid;grid-template-columns:200px 1fr;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.tr:last-child{border:0}.tk{background:var(--soft);padding:14px 16px;font-weight:600}.tv{padding:14px 16px;font-size:15px}.lnk{font-weight:600}
.sm{display:none}a[href^="tel:"],.nw{white-space:nowrap}a[href^="tel:"]{text-decoration:none}a.evt{font-weight:700;text-decoration:none}

.tw{overflow-x:auto;border:1px solid var(--line);border-top:0}table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:15px}th{text-align:left;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mut);padding:10px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);white-space:nowrap;background:var(--soft)}td{padding:10px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);vertical-align:top}
.day{border:2px solid var(--line);margin-top:20px;scroll-margin-top:56px}.dh{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;background:var(--client);color:#000;padding:22px 26px}.dh>a{text-decoration:none;opacity:.6}
.dd{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.14em;opacity:.7}.dh h3{margin:4px 0 0;font-size:26px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase}.tag{display:inline-block;margin-top:8px;padding:3px 10px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;background:rgba(0,0,0,.1);border-radius:4px}
.grp{padding:0 26px 8px}.gh{padding:8px 26px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--client) 55%,#fff);border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
h4{margin:14px 0 6px;font-size:13px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em}
.kv{display:grid;grid-template-columns:140px 1fr;gap:12px;padding:3px 0}.kv>span:first-child{color:var(--mut)}
.flt{border-left:3px solid var(--client);padding:6px 12px;margin:8px 0}.sec{border-left:3px solid var(--client);padding:4px 0 4px 12px;margin:0 0 8px}.sec .flt{border-left:0;padding:4px 0;margin:0 0 6px}a.map{text-decoration:none}a.doc{color:inherit;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:2px}.haddr{margin-bottom:10px}a.map:hover{text-decoration:underline}.fh{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:baseline}.fh em{color:var(--mut)}
.hotel{font-weight:600;font-size:16px}.lineup{display:grid;gap:2px}.slot{display:grid;grid-template-columns:120px 1fr;gap:12px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.slot.me{font-weight:800}.lineup{border:1px solid var(--line);margin-top:6px;max-width:520px;gap:0}.lineup .slot{padding:9px 16px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);align-items:center}.lineup .slot:first-child{border-top:0}.lineup .slot>span:first-child{white-space:nowrap}
.top-btn{position:fixed;right:16px;bottom:16px;padding:10px 14px;background:var(--ink);color:#fff;text-decoration:none;font-weight:600;font-size:13px;border-radius:4px}
@media print{nav.top,.top-btn,.bar a,.dh>a{display:none}.day{break-inside:avoid}}
@media(max-width:600px){body{font-size:15px}section{margin:20px 10px 0}.bar{padding:10px 14px}.bar h2{font-size:17px}.lg{display:none}.sm{display:inline}.tr{grid-template-columns:1fr}.tk{padding:10px 14px 2px;background:none;font-size:13px;color:var(--mut)}.tv{padding:0 14px 10px}.list .li{flex-direction:column;gap:2px;padding:10px 14px}.list .li>div:last-child{text-align:left}.days a{display:grid;grid-template-columns:82px 1fr auto;gap:8px;padding:10px 12px}.days small{min-width:0;font-size:14px}.days .loc{white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;font-size:15px}.days .tag{font-size:10px;padding:2px 6px;white-space:nowrap}.tw{overflow:visible;border:0}.tw table,.tw tbody,.tw tr,.tw td{display:block;width:100%}.tw thead{display:none}.tw tr{border:1px solid var(--line);border-top:0;padding:8px 14px}.tw td{display:grid;grid-template-columns:96px 1fr;gap:10px;padding:3px 0;border:0;white-space:normal}.tw td::before{content:attr(data-l);color:var(--mut);font-size:13px}.day{margin-top:16px}.dh{padding:16px}.dh h3{font-size:21px}.gh{padding:6px 16px}.grp{padding:0 16px 8px}.kv{grid-template-columns:104px 1fr;gap:10px}.kv,.slot,.tw td{font-size:14px}.slot{grid-template-columns:104px 1fr;gap:10px}.banner{height:110px}.banner h1{left:16px;font-size:24px}.meta{padding:20px 16px 4px}.top-btn{padding:8px 10px}}
</style></head><body><div class="page">
<header class="cover" id="top">
  <div class="banner" style="background:#A4CCC4"><h1>Zero</h1>
    <div class="diag" style="background:#000"><div class="hl"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Higher Ground"></div></div></div>
  <div class="meta"><h2>Australia</h2><p>October - November 2026</p></div>
  <div class="photo"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64,
